beliefs: The box reverses the order of characters in the input string [E1]
Reversal preserves case, digits, punctuation, and spaces exactly, only order changes [E1]
Trailing whitespace of all kinds is stripped from the input before reversal [E6, E12]
Leading spaces (0x20) are NOT stripped before reversal; they are preserved and end up at the end after reversal [E14, E15]
After reversal, leading whitespace of all kinds is stripped from the result [E7, E10, E13]
Equivalently: strip trailing whitespace (all kinds), reverse, then strip leading whitespace (all kinds) from the result [E14, E15, E13]
